name: NVIDIA MotionBricks (SOMA + Unitree G1 weights)
summary: Pretrained SafeTensors weights for MotionBricks (SIGGRAPH 2026), NVIDIA's real-time pose-conditioned motion generator for game characters (SOMA human skeleton) and the Unitree G1 humanoid. Give it recent poses and target poses, it generates the motion between them; Smart Primitives handle navigation and object interactions without retraining. Project page reports 15,000 FPS and 2 ms latency, trained on 350K+ mocap clips (Bones RigPlay 1). Code repo ships ready-to-use ONNX models.

access.notes: Weights: commercial use and derivatives allowed; keep notices, pass the license on, add 'Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement'. Bundled sample motions in the code repo are evaluation-only (NVIDIA Sample Data Evaluation License). Ungated.

procedure: To try demos: clone https://github.com/NVlabs/motionbricks, install Git LFS and uv, run git lfs pull and uv sync (ONNX models included; TensorRT demo needs an NVIDIA GPU).
To get the weights: hf download nvidia/MotionBricks --local-dir MotionBricks (add --include "soma/*" or "g1/*" for one model).
Verify files with the SHA256SUMS and manifest.json in each model folder.
Export ONNX with the repo's tools/onnx guide, using the matching family folder.

stats.count: 2 model families (SOMA ~200M params, G1 ~195M params; 3 networks each)

verdict.why: Official NVIDIA weights, ungated, commercially usable under a permissive model agreement, with Apache-2.0 code and ONNX models ready to run. Real-time motion for game characters and G1. Sample motion clips are eval-only, and robots still need a separate tracking controller.
